candidate_priority: first maximum stratum score, then farthest Euclidean coverage in saved world; ties by ascending source vertex ID

stratum_rules.natural_concave: signed normal neighbor displacement / mean incident edge > .01, upper20percent positive tail
stratum_rules.source_boundary_near: 3 to6 edge hops from original open boundary, first greatest hop

eligibility: component>=512, center normal coherence>=.5, no incident degenerate face or nonmanifold edge; historic Yanyite center24205 excluded
pre_generation_rejection: center on patch boundary or fewer128free points
support normals have nonpositive alignment to center normal
post_generation_rejection: incident face normal reversal against reference

generation.direction: negative center full-incident area-weighted saved-snapshot normal

network_feature_contract.positions_and_normals: vector channels for proper SO(3)-covariant residual head

coupled_contact_evaluation: not run for dataset generation; full corresponding domains required after trained candidate proposal
offcenter_rule: same allowed region; original-center distance [.25D,.5D], boundary distance >=.6D; descending center distance then ascending source ID; first candidate passing original support counts and orientation; recompute D; no extra control
inputs_legacy_unit_names: origin_world_m and scale_m retained as whitelist names; values are native source units
reserved_test_allowed_checks: PLY, topology, generator formula, serialization; no model or MLS scoring
